description: This file defines the interface for the Little Sheens C API, including type definitions, function declarations for context management, processing, pattern matching, and object management related to machine states and messages.

methods.name: mach_make_ctx
methods.description: Creates a new Little Sheens context.

methods.name: mach_set_ctx
methods.description: Sets the given context as the active global context.

methods.name: mach_get_ctx
methods.description: Returns the current active context.

methods.name: mach_open
methods.description: Initializes the Little Sheens runtime.

methods.name: mach_close
methods.description: Frees the Little Sheens runtime.

methods.name: mach_process
methods.description: Processes a machine state and message, returning the new state and emitted messages.

methods.name: mach_set_spec_provider
methods.description: Registers a spec provider function for resolving specs.

methods.name: mach_eval
methods.description: Executes ECMAScript source code and writes the string result.

methods.name: mach_match
methods.description: Performs pattern matching and outputs bindings as JSON.

methods.name: mach_make_crew
methods.description: Creates a new Crew with a specified ID.

methods.name: mach_set_machine
methods.description: Adds or updates a machine in a Crew.

methods.name: mach_rem_machine
methods.description: Removes a machine from a Crew.

methods.name: mach_crew_process
methods.description: Processes a message within a Crew, outputting machine states.

methods.name: mach_crew_update
methods.description: Updates Crew state based on processed steppeds.

methods.name: mach_get_emitted
methods.description: Extracts emitted messages from steppeds.

methods.name: mach_do_emitted
methods.description: Iterates over emitted messages.

methods.name: mach_set_spec_cache_limit
methods.description: Sets the limit for the spec cache entries.

methods.name: mach_clear_spec_cache
methods.description: Clears the spec cache.

methods.name: mach_enable_spec_cache
methods.description: Enables or disables the spec cache.

methods.name: mach_dump_stack
methods.description: Outputs the current Duktape stack for debugging.
